dreamteamer.title: Assets
dreamteamer.description: A file the UI shows — an icon, a logo, an avatar, an illustration — as a `codec: file` record whose id IS its provenance (`icons/<set>/<name>`, `logos/<slug>`, `avatars/<contact-id>`), 200 KB each, licences listed once in this module's README. The commons every other module's pictures point at; ships no records.
